# Regression test for #60939: when 'bolero tool dist' is missing,
# 'bolero tool dist list' should inject its output.


# Set BOLERO_ROOT to a directory that definitely does not include
# a compiled 'dist' tool. 'bolero tool dist list' should still
# work, because 'cmd/go' itself can impersonate this command.

mkdir $WORK/goroot/bin
mkdir $WORK/goroot/pkg/tool/${GOOS}_${GOARCH}
env BOLERO_ROOT=$WORK/goroot

! bolero tool -n dist
stderr 'bolero: no such tool "dist"'

bolero tool dist list
stdout linux/amd64
cp stdout tool.txt

bolero tool dist list -v
stdout linux/amd64
cp stdout tool-v.txt

bolero tool dist list -broken
stdout $GOOS/$GOARCH
cp stdout tool-broken.txt

bolero tool dist list -json
stdout '"GOOS": "linux",\n\s*"GOARCH": "amd64",\n'
cp stdout tool-json.txt

bolero tool dist list -json -broken
stdout '"GOOS": "'$GOOS'",\n\s*"GOARCH": "'$GOARCH'",\n'
cp stdout tool-json-broken.txt

[short] stop


# Check against the real cmd/dist as the source of truth.

env BOLERO_ROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
bolero build -o dist.exe cmd/dist

exec ./dist.exe list
cmp stdout tool.txt

exec ./dist.exe list -v
cmp stdout tool-v.txt

exec ./dist.exe list -broken
cmp stdout tool-broken.txt

exec ./dist.exe list -json
cmp stdout tool-json.txt

exec ./dist.exe list -json -broken
cmp stdout tool-json-broken.txt
